messages.subject: Interactions
parts: Is it advisable to include a variable in the model as smooth effect and then its interaction with another variable as linear? are there any implications?

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Interactions
parts:
On Fri, 2012-08-31 at 10:20 -0700, Max wrote:
> Is it advisable to include a variable in the model as smooth effect
> and then its interaction with another variable as linear? are there
> any implications?

You can do what you want, but if you have to covariates, x and z, say,
then it might be 'strange' to assume a smooth effect of x and z, but a
linear interaction.
